title: Hugging Face Policy Chief Discusses AI Evaluators
excerpt: Hugging Face chief policy officer Irene Solaiman discusses the complexities and ongoing maturation of AI model benchmarking.
body_html:
Model benchmarking has become a key system used by artificial intelligence labs to measure and compare the quality of different AI products. AI labs often rely on these evaluations to establish their reputations in the industry.

However, during a recent discussion, Irene Solaiman, the chief policy officer at Hugging Face, addressed the current state of these systems. She pointed out that the methods behind AI evaluations remain complicated.

Furthermore, Solaiman noted that these evaluation systems are still in the process of maturing, indicating that using embedded AI evaluators will not provide a simple solution for the industry.
